messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — need a quick-turn webinar next Tues 9am PT (APAC-friendly). Topic: benchmarking inference latency vs cost. Need reg page, Zoom setup with cloud recording + transcript, captions, and post-event lead routing to HubSpot. Can we ship by Thu EOD?
Priya: On it. Do we have a registration page template to reuse? Prefer 'Webinar Lite' so we don't rebuild fields.
Jamie: I can grab the template and update copy. What should the hero + 2 bullets be?
Sam: Also need GA + UTM tags and the thank-you flow (replay link + 1-question NPS). Suggest utm_source=organic&utm_campaign=bench_jun.
Luis: Sales request: include a checkbox "Interested in Dedicated demo" and ensure we get company size + role. We'll want a CSV export 24-48h after event.
Priya: Zoom config proposal: co-hosts Alex, Priya; auto-record to cloud; participants muted on entry; live transcript on. Waiting room off to minimize friction unless objections.
Alex: Waiting room off is fine. Must record to cloud, transcripts enabled, and save raw to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/bench-2026/.
zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode sent via DM). Cloud recording: enabled. Transcript: enabled.
Jamie: Draft copy (short):
- Hero: "Ship faster with predictable inference"
- Bullet 1: Live benchmark comparing latency vs cost across common configs
- Bullet 2: Actionable tuning + model routing playbook
CTA: "Reserve your seat — limited capacity"
Priya: Recording ownership: @Priya will upload raw; @Jamie will clean transcript + request captions. Post-event flow proposed: raw -> 24h auto-transcribe -> clip pipeline -> 48h nurture email w/ highlights -> 5-day sales CSV export.
Sam: HubSpot form mappings — fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, company_size, interested_in_dedicated (checkbox), utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_content. Embed snippet below:
```
<form id=\"hs_form\">\n  <input name=\"email\">\n  <input name=\"first_name\">\n  <input name=\"company\">\n  <input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"interested_in_dedicated\">\n</form>
```
Alex: Also planning an A/B of messaging on the reg page: variant A = cost-first, variant B = speed-first. Tag registrants with utm_content=cost or utm_content=speed for downstream reporting.
Luis: For follow-up, AEs will prioritize anyone who checked "Interested in Dedicated demo" or company_size > 500. We'll want Lead Score exported to my inbox and HubSpot owner set to @Luis for qualified leads.
Priya: Timeline/checklist: reg page published by Thu 5pm, Zoom test Wed 11am, slides due Mon EOD, recording retention = 90 days, captions + SRT attached to asset. I'll open the preflight thread tomorrow morning.
Sam: I'll set UTMs, GA event, and shortlink redirect to /assets/bench-playbook?token={{uuid}}. Plan: bit.ly/redwood-bench for marketing CTAs.
Alex: Great. Any blockers?
Jamie: Need legal sign-off for third-party benchmark mentions — pinged @Legal. Otherwise no blockers.
Priya: Marking as on-track. :thumbsup:
